description: Call before using any image, text, dataset, code, font or model you did not create. Free, no key. What a license from the license library (CC0, CC BY/SA/NC/ND 4.0, MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, ISC, GPL/LGPL/AGPL 3.0, MPL-2.0, Unlicense, OFL-1.1, ODbL, ODC-By, PDDL, CDLA-Permissive-2.0) permits, prohibits, leaves for human review or does not document, for the intended use you give, with the duties that come with it. Any other SPDX License List id answers needs_review with the official link. Or pass source_url (GitHub repo, Hugging Face model card, npm or PyPI package, Wikimedia Commons file, Unsplash or Pexels photo) to check the license that source declares. Call with {"license": "CC-BY-4.0", "intended_use": {"commercial_use": true, "attribution_planned": true}}.

intended_use.description: Intended use. Every true flag is a right the assessment must find documented; omitted flags are false. Unknown fields are refused (invalid_intended_use). For instance {"commercial_use":true,"deployment":true,"attribution_planned":true,"duration_days":365}

duration_days.description: Whole days of use (1 to 36500), or null for no fixed term

geography.description: worldwide (default) or a region code such as US, EU, UK

license.description: SPDX id, e.g. CC-BY-NC-4.0 or Apache-2.0 (any SPDX License List id; uncurated ones answer needs_review)

source_url.description: Instead of license: a page on GitHub, Hugging Face, npm, PyPI, Wikimedia Commons, Unsplash or Pexels; the license it declares is checked

name: check_license
title: Check a use against a license
